amenitiesDescription:
Villa Miami's lifestyle is built entirely around Major Food Group — the team behind Carbone, ZZ's Club, and Dirty French. Residents access a two-level bayfront Italian-inspired restaurant, a residents-only juice bar and coffee lounge, poolside food and beverage, private chef services, pantry stocking, Sadelle's morning service, and VIP access across all MFG restaurants globally. The Club spans three levels: a Great Room, private dining, library, screening room, game room, kids and family lounge, and dedicated Estate Manager and In-House Curator offices.

The Wellness Level features an outdoor pool, full spa, herbal steam room, sauna, hot and cold plunge pools, chromotherapy showers, relaxation lounge, and salon. With 20,000 sq ft of amenities and a Baywalk connection, Villa Miami sets a new standard for new condo development in Miami's Edgewater.

investmentIntelligence.thesis: Villa Miami is the highest-conviction branded-residence bet in Edgewater. Major Food Group's first residential tower attaches a globally recognized hospitality brand to a 70-unit boutique floor plate at a moment when Edgewater inventory is still dominated by 300- to 400-unit towers. Construction risk is largely retired at 65% topped off, and MLS resale activity already prints around $2,054 PSF before any units have closed.

investmentThesis: 75% sold. Major Food Group is operationally embedded in the building — this is not a brand licensing deal. Residents receive in-home dining by MFG, pantry stocking, private chef services, Sadelle's morning service, a two-level bayfront Italian restaurant, a residents-only juice bar and coffee lounge, poolside food and beverage, and VIP access across all MFG restaurants globally. The depth of integration is unprecedented in Miami branded residential and creates an ownership experience that competing branded buildings cannot replicate without an analogous F&B partner. Additional features include a rooftop helipad (FAA approval pending), private dock and boat slip (permit pending), 24-hour valet, bank vault storage, and EV charging. A dedicated Estate Manager and In-House Curator round out the service model. Delivery targeted late 2027.
name: Villa Miami
parking: Valet + Private Garage (plus complimentary Villa Escalade car service)
residenceContent: A 56-story bayfront tower with three residence types: Villa Piano (full-floor, 4–5 bedrooms), Villa Mezzo (half-floor, 3–4 bedrooms), and two-story penthouses with private pools on the upper levels. Every home offers 10-to-11-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and dual sunrise and sunset terraces oriented to Biscayne Bay. Interiors by Vicky Charles feature custom Italian kitchens with Gaggenau and Sub-Zero appliances, wide-plank European oak, natural stone bathrooms, and hand-selected fixtures. Landscape architecture is by Enea Garden Design under Enzo Enea, wrapping the podium and pool deck. The full-floor and half-floor footprints — one to two residences per level, with private elevator entry — read closer to a single-family estate than a typical condominium tower.
